# PHFrame HTTP API reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m public_health_framework.http_reference --write docs`; do not edit by hand. -->

Version 0.9.0a3 · OpenAPI 3.1.0 document: [`openapi.json`](openapi.json), also served by every application at `/api/openapi.json`.

Routes and methods are covered by the PHFrame stability policy (docs/api-stability.md). Record endpoints are generated for every dataset in phframe.yaml, so `{dataset}` is a configured dataset name and record fields follow that dataset's schema. JSON responses wrap results in `data`; errors use the `Error` schema. When `access_mode` is `private`, requests need a `phframe_session` cookie from `/api/auth/login`; write requests may instead send `Authorization: Bearer $PHFRAME_API_TOKEN`.

Every response may also be `429` when a client exceeds the rate limit (`PHFRAME_RATE_LIMIT` requests per minute, 10 per minute for sign-in) or `413` when the body exceeds `PHFRAME_MAX_BODY_BYTES`. Session-protected `/api` routes return `401` and pages redirect to `/login` when the application is private.

## System

Liveness, readiness, metadata, and the operations audit trail.

### `GET /api`

**Project metadata.**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Datasets, analytics definitions, dashboards, UI, and connectors configured for the project. | `application/json` [`ApiIndex`](#apiindex) |

### `GET /api/openapi.json`

**OpenAPI document.**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | This reference as an OpenAPI 3.1 document. | `application/json` object |

### `GET /api/operations/audit`

**Operations audit trail.** Every write request (any method other than GET, HEAD, or OPTIONS), newest first.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | integer | Most recent events to return. |

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Success. | `application/json` `data`: array of [`OperationsAuditEvent`](#operationsauditevent) |

### `GET /health`

**Liveness check.**

No session required.

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The application is running. | `application/json` [`Health`](#health) |

### `GET /ready`

**Readiness check.**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The database is reachable. `warning` lists production configuration issues. | `application/json` [`Readiness`](#readiness) |
| 503 | The database or configuration is not ready. | `application/json` [`NotReady`](#notready) |

## Authentication

Session sign-in for private applications.

### `POST /api/auth/login`

**Sign in.** Limited to 10 attempts per client per minute.

No session required.

Request body: `application/json`, [`LoginRequest`](#loginrequest).

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Signed in; sets the `phframe_session` cookie for 24 hours. | `application/json` `data`: [`LoginResult`](#loginresult) |
| 400 | The body is not a JSON object. | `application/json` [`Error`](#error) |
| 401 | Invalid username or password. | `application/json` [`Error`](#error) |

### `POST /api/auth/logout`

**Sign out.**

No session required.

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Signed out; clears the session cookie. | `application/json` `data`: [`LoginResult`](#loginresult) |

### `GET /api/auth/status`

**Session status.**

No session required.

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Success. | `application/json` `data`: [`AuthStatus`](#authstatus) |

## Records

Automatically generated CRUD endpoints for each configured dataset.

### `POST /api/project/datasets/{dataset}/fields`

**Add an optional field to a dataset.** Adds the column to the database and to phframe.yaml. New fields must be optional.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | path | string |  |

Request body: `application/json`, [`FieldCreate`](#fieldcreate).

|---|---|---|

| 422 | The request body or parameters are invalid. | `application/json` [`Error`](#error) |

### `GET /api/{dataset}`

**List records.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | path | string |  |
| `limit` | query | integer | Page size. |
| `offset` | query | integer | Records to skip. |
| `filter` | query | string | Name of a saved filter for this dataset. |

## Imports

Browser file imports, column mappings, and import history.

### `POST /api/browser-import/{dataset}`

**Import an uploaded file or staged version.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | path | string |  |
| `filename` | query | string | File name, when uploading a file. |
| `sheet` | query | string | Excel sheet index or name. |
| `version_id` | query | integer | Import a staged version instead of an upload; approves it on success. |
| `mapping` | query | string | Source column to dataset field mapping, as JSON. |
| `dry_run` | query | boolean | Validate without writing records. |

Request body (optional): `application/octet-stream`, string (binary).

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Success. | `application/json` `data`: [`ImportResult`](#importresult) |
| 422 | The import had row errors, or the request is invalid. | `application/json` `data`: [`ImportResult`](#importresult) or [`Error`](#error) |

### `POST /api/browser-import/{dataset}/preview`

**Preview and stage an uploaded file.** Stages the upload as an immutable dataset version and runs a quality review. Uploads are limited to 25 MB.

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | path | string |  |
| `filename` | query | string | File name; its extension selects CSV, Excel, JSON, or XML parsing. |
| `sheet` | query | string | Excel sheet index or name. |

Request body: `application/octet-stream`, string (binary).

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Success. | `application/json` `data`: [`ImportPreview`](#importpreview) |
| 422 | The request body or parameters are invalid. | `application/json` [`Error`](#error) |

### `GET /api/import-example/{dataset}`

**Download an example import file.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | path | string |  |
| `format` | query | string (csv, json, xml) | File format. |

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | A one-row example in the requested format. | `text/csv` string; `application/json` array of object; `application/xml` string |
| 404 | Not found. | `application/json` [`Error`](#error) |
| 422 | The request body or parameters are invalid. | `application/json` [`Error`](#error) |
